food.scope: USDA September 2026 mainland age>=1 modeled food budget; 2024 ACS population only as labeled reference

housing.scope: FY2026 revised HUD gross FMR; adult individual bedrooms except couple sharing; <=2 minors/room; <=4 bedrooms; supported geographies
blockers: Complete mutually exclusive geographic and large-home exclusion reconciliation

transportation.reference_vehicle: economical reliable used compact vehicle (illustrative Honda Civic case)
transportation.scope: One-vehicle annual economic ownership cost reference only; not a complete national mobility model
limitations: Insurance, depreciation/resale, maintenance, fees, financing are hypothetical scenario assumptions, not validated September 2026 geographic prices
No verified local household transit access or public transit fare allocation
No household-specific required vehicle counts or national weighted transport result
No independent replication or component price benchmarking sufficient for full approval
12,000 miles is a chosen normative reference, not an observed adequate mileage level

integration_status: three controlled reference standards bundled; no unified household-level 3-pillar national run
